title: My First Dentist Visit
blurb: Arrive, meet the team, see the chair and the light, hear about the tools, and practice a pause signal.

text.title: For the grown-up reading along
text.std: {Name} can read this book before {their} visit, as many times as {they} {v:likes|like}. Real visits differ. Ask the dental office what {name} will see, and tell them about the pause signal.
text.easy: {Name} can read this book before {their} visit, as many times as {they} {v:likes|like}. Real visits differ. Ask the dental office what {name} will see, and tell them about the pause signal.

variants.std: Read this book together before the visit, as many times as you like. Real visits differ. Ask the dental office what to expect, and tell them about the pause signal.
variants.easy: Read this book together before the visit, as many times as you like. Real visits differ. Ask the dental office what to expect, and tell them about the pause signal.

back.alt: Back cover with a note for the grown-up.

text.title: My First Dentist Visit
text.std: A story for {name}
text.easy: A story for {name}

noName.std: A story about a first visit
noName.easy: A story about a first visit

pages.alt: Title page. {child} waves hello.

text.std: My name is {name}. Soon I will visit the dentist.
text.easy: I am {name}. I will visit the dentist.

noName.std: Soon I will visit the dentist.

pages.alt: {child} stands at home near a calendar with one day circled.

text.std: A dentist helps people take care of their teeth.
text.easy: A dentist helps with teeth.

pages.alt: A dentist in a white coat waves beside pictures of a tooth and a toothbrush.

text.std: A grown-up I know will come with me.
text.easy: My grown-up comes with me.

pages.alt: {child} stands beside a grown-up at home.

text.std: We go to the dental office. It may be a building I have not seen before.
text.easy: We go to the dental office.

pages.alt: {child} and a grown-up arrive outside the dental office. {child} points to the door.

text.std: Inside, there is a waiting room. There may be chairs, books, or toys.
text.easy: Inside is a waiting room.

pages.alt: {child} and a grown-up stand in a waiting room with chairs and a bookshelf.

text.std: We tell the person at the desk that we are here.
text.easy: We say we are here.

pages.alt: {child} waves to a person behind the front desk.

text.std: I might wait for a little while. I can bring something that helps me wait.
text.easy: I might wait a little.

pages.alt: {child} sits in the waiting room next to a grown-up.

text.std: Someone from the dental team says my name. It is my turn.
text.easy: Someone says my name. It is my turn.

noName.std: Someone from the dental team calls for me. It is my turn.
noName.easy: Someone calls for me. It is my turn.

pages.alt: A dental team member in scrubs waves to {child}.

text.std: We walk to a room with a big chair.
text.easy: We go to a room with a big chair.

pages.alt: {child} looks at a big dental chair. A team member points to it.

text.std: The chair can lean back. I can sit in it, and my grown-up can stay close.
text.easy: I can sit in the big chair. My grown-up stays close.

variants.std: The big chair can lean back. The team and my grown-up help me find a way to sit that works for me.
variants.easy: We find a way to sit that works for me.

pages.alt: {child} is seated for the visit. A grown-up stands close by.

text.std: There is a bright light above the chair. It helps the dentist see my teeth. I can close my eyes if it feels too bright.
text.easy: There is a bright light. I can close my eyes.

pages.alt: A lamp shines a soft yellow light over {child}.

text.std: The dentist says hello. The dentist may wear a mask and gloves.
text.easy: The dentist says hello.

pages.alt: The dentist, wearing a mask and gloves, waves hello to {child}.

text.std: The dentist has small tools. I can ask to see them first.
text.easy: The dentist has tools. I can ask to see them.

pages.alt: Four picture cards: a small mirror, a tooth counter, a polisher and a water sprayer.

text.std: A tiny mirror helps the dentist look at my teeth.
text.easy: A tiny mirror helps the dentist see.

pages.alt: {child} opens wide while the dentist looks. A card shows a tiny mirror.

text.std: The dentist may count my teeth. One, two, three.
text.easy: The dentist may count my teeth.

pages.alt: {child} opens wide next to three tooth cards numbered one, two and three.

text.std: Some tools make sounds. One may buzz or hum. One may spray a little water.
text.easy: Some tools make sounds. One may spray water.

pages.alt: Three picture cards: a buzzing polisher, a sound symbol and a water sprayer.

text.std: A small straw may slurp the water away. It can sound funny.
text.easy: A small straw slurps the water.

pages.alt: A team member stands beside {child}. A card shows a small suction straw.

text.std: If I need a pause, I can raise my hand.
text.easy: I can raise my hand for a pause.

variants.std: If I need a pause, I can raise my hand or use my device.
variants.easy: I can raise my hand or use my device.

pages.alt: {child} raises a hand. The dentist waits.

text.std: My grown-up and I can tell the dentist about my signal before we start. Let’s practice now.
text.easy: We tell the dentist my signal. Let’s practice.

pages.alt: {child} practices raising a hand next to a card that says pause.

text.std: I can ask a question at any time. I can ask, “What is that?”
text.easy: I can ask a question.

pages.alt: {child} points and asks a question. A card shows a question mark.

text.std: When the dentist is finished, the visit is over.
text.easy: Then the visit is over.

pages.alt: {child} and the dentist wave goodbye in the dental room.

text.std: We say goodbye. Then my grown-up and I go home.
text.easy: We say goodbye and go home.

pages.alt: {child} waves goodbye outside the dental office.

text.std: Now I know what I might see, hear, and do at the dentist.
text.easy: Now I know about the dentist.

pages.alt: {child} waves under a star, a tooth and a heart. The end.
